issues.where: the slab edges at the lower right and the pale ledges along the near bench (crops set-A-03 right, set-A-02 bottom left)
issues.what: the rock is soft, pale and smeared like clay or draped cloth. Its edges are faceted and hard-cut polygons, and the texture is stretched across the tilted faces
issues.fix: remodel the near rock with real fracture geometry, sharp chipped edges and a close-range texture that is not stretched. Break up the pale draped slabs

issues.where: the near rock under the carcass and its far edge on the right (crops set-A-08 bottom right, set-A-09 right)
issues.what: the foreground rock has a fur-like or carpet noise texture that is stretched and soft at close range. The slab behind meets it on a thin hard line with a brown seam, like a separate mesh laid on top
issues.fix: replace the noise with real rock grain at the right scale and blend the two slabs where they meet, with contact shadow and debris

issues.where: the shallow water on the left near the bench (crop set-A-02 bottom right)
issues.what: the water is a flat brown tint with sparkles stamped on it. It shows no depth and no reflection of the rock beside it, and its edge against the stone is a jagged hard cutout with no wet margin
issues.fix: give the water depth, reflect the rock and sky in it, and add a darkened wet band and a soft meniscus where it meets the stone

issues.where: the far flat and the herd at the left (crop set-A-02 top left)
issues.what: the distant animals are pale and smooth, like models, with near-identical poses and duplicated silhouettes. Their reflections are as sharp as the bodies and show no ripples, and there is little haze on them
issues.fix: vary the poses and scale, add haze with distance, and break up the reflections with ripples

issues.where: the mist in the gorge and the open water in the middle distance (crop set-A-02 top right)
issues.what: the vapour is a flat grey veil with no internal structure and no light in it. The water under it is a smeared, low-detail surface with a visible straight line across it
issues.fix: give the vapour volume, wisps and back-lit edges from the sun, and remove the line across the water

issues.where: the edges of the near and middle animals (crop set-A-05 top right)
issues.what: a bright halo or fringe outlines the legs and body, like a compositing matte edge. The skin reads as a smooth sculpted model and carries no wet, salt or mud where the legs enter the water
issues.fix: fix the matte or defocus edge, add wet darkening, a water line and splash or drips on the lower legs

issues.where: the dark water on the right (crop set-A-06)
issues.what: the water is a flat, muddy grey with almost no detail or reflection of the sky. The leg reflections smear without a matching surface
issues.fix: give the surface sky reflection, fine ripples and a gradient with depth

issues.where: the carcass on the rock (crop set-A-09 left)
issues.what: the hide reads as draped cloth with a repeated pore or dot pattern. It casts little contact shadow, and the scattered pebbles look stamped
issues.fix: add contact occlusion under the body, vary the skin detail, and settle it into the surface with dust or salt

issues.where: the fume over the gorge at the right (crop set-A-08 top right and bottom left)
issues.what: the vapour is a flat tint over a blurred cliff and shows no light from the low sun
issues.fix: add volumetric structure and sun scatter to the fume

issues.where: the round disc on the water at the upper right of the gorge
issues.what: a perfect circular disc sits on the surface like a placed prop
issues.fix: remove it or give it natural form
